parameters.name: Area
parameters.description:
The prefetch area. Valid values:
- domestic: the Chinese mainland.
- overseas: outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China).
- global: global acceleration.
 
If you do not specify this parameter, the default prefetch area is the acceleration region configured for your domain name.

parameters.name: PlayUrl
parameters.description: The live stream URLs. You can specify multiple URLs separated by commas (,). A maximum of 100 URLs can be specified.

parameters.name: PreloadedEndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the prefetch task in UTC. Example: 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 6 hours.

parameters.name: PreloadedStartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the prefetch task in UTC. Example: 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z. If you do not specify this parameter, the default prefetch duration is 1 hour.
